The learning record identifies only matrix_transpose_v1 from task A, records that the task-A baseline was not exact, verifies the task-A holder commitment, and contains no task-B output cells or answer-bearing derivative.
The task-B prediction is the transpose of the task-B input, is bound to the task-A learning-record digest, and records task_b_output_unrevealed=true before scoring.

Deterministic recomputation gives baseline task A 3/9 exact cells (0.3333333333333333), baseline task B 22/36 (0.6111111111111112), and adapted task B 36/36 (1.0) with exact-grid true and strict improvement true.

Replay accepted the first effect and rejected the duplicate under digest 8952cf12bfe66859fd4256fd081a3cdc952e2cc5f1d011cb90c6b0caf8f13b84.
The ARC source before/after head, object-count digest, status digest, and status-line count are identical, establishing zero upstream writes within the recorded audit.
